high_level_description: The image depicts a fashion show scene. Two models are walking down the runway, both dressed in matching light gray suits with white shirts and patterned ties. The model on the left is wearing glasses and has their hair styled in a sleek manner, while the model on the right has short, neatly groomed hair. They are both wearing casual sneakers, which contrasts with the formal attire of their suits. The runway is well-lit, with a spotlight illuminating the models as they walk. The audience is seated on either side of the runway, observing the show.
